task: Audit constraints faced during pitch deck carousel and PowerPoint export implementation, synthesize lessons learned, and codify prevention rules across AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, workspace-rules.md, memories/repo/, and skills dictionary
rootCausesIdentified: Docker client container 'cms-client' runs an isolated node_modules environment; installing packages solely on the host leads to Vite module resolution overlay errors.
Database entity records may already contain classification prefixes (e.g. team.name = 'Team Gamma'), leading to duplicate prefixes like 'Team Team Gamma' when naive string interpolation is used.
Slide presentation previews require strict 16:9 widescreen canvas constraints (aspect-video) and input-guarded keyboard listeners to avoid layout clipping and unwanted slide shifts during form input.

lessonsLearned: Always synchronize npm dependencies into running Docker containers ('docker exec cms-client npm install ...') and restart Vite before running Playwright visual audits.
Always sanitize entity names with regex ('name.replace(/^Prefix\s+/i, '')') before prefixing in UI templates to eliminate string duplication.
Slide presentation canvases require aspect-video and input-guarded keyboard listeners to eliminate visual clipping and navigation collisions while typing.
